title: Little Boy Cleaning Glass Door with Spray Bottle, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white snapshot depicting a young boy from behind, standing up on a chair to clean a dark glass window or sliding patio door. On a table in the foreground sits a vintage glass spray bottle of cleaning fluid alongside a section of newspaper reading 'Times Classified Ads', which was commonly used for streak-free window wiping. The boy wears a white T-shirt and high-waisted belted trousers, capturing an endearing mid-century domestic scene of childhood household chores.
